dogecoin.text:
Essentially: $doge best inflation hedge of all time much greater than $btc in terms of generating ROI during inflation

#btc not an inflation hedge, but an alt. option for those who no longer want to be coerced into a monetary system that’s supply can be manipulated by CBs

I think in hindsight we’ll recognize that the most highly speculative assets like $doge were the best inflation hedges bc they were essentially levered instruments

While $btc was a monetary movement that found it’s use case when currency debasement coverage went mainstream
